ABOUT_SECTION.DESCRIPTION:
I recently completed my Master’s Degree in Computer Engineering at Politecnico di Torino, after earning a Bachelor’s in Engineering And Management from the same university. My academic journey has allowed me to explore the spectrum of software development, with a growing passion for building user-centered and accessible digital solutions.
I’m particularly driven by the goal of designing systems that truly serve users, with strong attention to accessibility, usability, and clean design. I enjoy working in Agile teams and constantly seek to improve both product quality and team collaboration. I’m now excited to apply my skills, expand my knowledge, and contribute to impactful projects as I begin my professional journey in the tech industry.

PROJECTS_SECTION.MASTER_THESIS_DESCRIPTION: Master's thesis project aimed at redesigning the thesis management system of Politecnico di Torino, focusing on requirements analysis and user experience. The final result consists of an OpenAPI specification and a web application that allows students to effectively consult thesis proposals.
PROJECTS_SECTION.PORTFOLIO_DESCRIPTION: A web application showcasing my profile, skills, and experiences, featuring a clear, modern, and easily navigable interface. This personal project was developed to create an online portfolio while also deepening my understanding of Angular. The site has been published on GitHub Pages.
PROJECTS_SECTION.TEAMHUB_DESCRIPTION: A mobile application designed to facilitate effective teamwork by providing features for task management, team collaboration, and performance tracking.
PROJECTS_SECTION.TMS_DESCRIPTION: A web application that allows students to manage their thesis projects, teachers to supervise them and secretary clerks to monitor the process.
PROJECTS_SECTION.URBANHUB_DESCRIPTION: A high-fidelity web application prototype aimed at optimizing the trip planning process using a simulated AI assistance. It offers users personalized route suggestions, attraction recommendations, and transportation options.
